method: Hierarchical softmax ladder. Report the deepest taxonomic string whose calibrated score passes the threshold; otherwise step up to genus → family → display group → 'Animal, unidentified'.
notes: Threshold 0.7 is the audit default. Field-crop calibration (~200 labelled crops/camera) is skipped for this release.
Synthetic ladder tests check hierarchy behaviour only — not field accuracy.
Set AG_BIOCLIP=1 (relay/.env.example) with open_clip_torch installed; BioCLIP 2 weights download from Hugging Face on first warmup.
status_note: Field-crop collection skipped by project decision (2026-11-11). Do not treat 0.7 as field-calibrated; screening / education use only.
